description: Returns the current user, company (the workspace, with its name; null for an unnamed workspace), role catalog with permissions, connected messaging accounts, and the Knowledge Base in one response. This connection is bound to exactly one workspace: every tool reads and writes only that workspace, and another workspace of the same login needs its own connection. On the first page wiki.guide is the Operating Guide (nextOffset marks where the full page continues) and wiki.procedures lists procedures with whenToUse. wiki.items are knowledge pages, ten per page in creation order, each with id, title, url, timestamps and a short opening excerpt, not the complete page. wiki.nextPage is the wikiPage value of the following catalog page. wiki is omitted without Knowledge Base Read. A page's owner and verifiedAt (when someone last confirmed it is correct) appear when set. For someone who may edit pages, wiki.upkeep on the first page counts what is open, and is omitted when nothing is: openQuestions the Knowledge Base could not answer, orphanPages that no other page links to and pagesWithDeadLinks that link to a page that no longer exists; the two link counts are left out while links of recently changed pages are still being read. Each role carries its full permission list; without role management only the user's own role is listed, and a user's roleId matches a role id. Each connected account includes { id, provider, status, emailAddress, displayName, shared, isOwner, lastSyncedAt, linkedinProducts }; the id is the connectedAccountId of that account and status is its connection status. lastSyncedAt is the time the account's last history import finished, not the time of its newest message: a message that arrives later leaves it unchanged. For LinkedIn, linkedinProducts lists which products the account can send from (classic, sales_navigator, recruiter).

wikiPage.description: Knowledge Base catalog page, ten entries per page (default 1)
